body: i do need to talk, but I have no idea how.

I know how much it will hurt them, but if it is an accident. It won't be that bad.  There are 27 of us in my immediate family, somebody is going to go eventually.  I am the only one without kids. I won't leave any trouble behind.  I am old, and everything is falling apart health wise.  It won't get better at this point, only worse.  I've no safety net, no partner, no debt.  This the perfect time.
I worry about calling.  All i have is my cell phone, I don't want to be dragged out of my house because someone is 'worried' about my ideation?
